title: 第二百八十五章 张三的决心第二百八十四章 兵出险招
slug: 斗罗之张三的逆袭人生
content_zh:
晨光未明，夜色与黎明交界的混沌中，张三与朱华音沿着林间泥泞的小路疾行。
空气中弥漫着越来越浓的血腥味和魂兽特有的腥臊气息。
地上开始出现杂乱的蛛足印痕，有些脚印深达数寸，显然是体型庞大的精英魂兽留下的。
越往前，痕迹越密集，泥土被翻搅得一片狼藉。
“快了……”朱华音压低声音，脸色凝重。她虽然魂力尚未恢复，但魂圣级别的感知依旧敏锐，“前方三里，魂力波动异常密集……数量极多。”
两人对视一眼，加快脚步。
穿过一片稀疏的树林，前方景象豁然映入眼帘。
在一片坡地的下方，原本平静的田野与村道，此刻已被一片蠕动的黑色洪流彻底覆盖！
成千上万的蜘蛛魂兽如同决堤的潮水，正朝着蛛网镇的方向汹涌而去！小的如拳头，大的如磨盘，灰黑色的甲壳在黎明微光中反射着冰冷的光泽，八只幽绿的复眼汇成一片死亡的光海，窸窸窣窣的爬行声汇成令人头皮发麻的低鸣。
而在这黑色洪流经过的路上，更是寸草不生。
几座散落在田野边缘的农舍已成废墟。茅草屋顶被掀翻，土墙坍塌，院子里散落着破碎的农具和沾满泥土的衣物。
一具被啃食得只剩骨架的残骸半埋在倒塌的篱笆下，头颅滚落一旁，空洞的眼窝望着灰蒙蒙的天空。
更远处的一个小村庄已化作人间炼狱。火焰在几间屋舍上跳跃，黑烟滚滚升起，与晨雾混在一起。村道上随处可见破碎的马车和横七竖八的尸骸，有的被蛛网黏在墙上，有的被撕扯得支离破碎，暗红的血液浸透了泥土，在微光中泛着诡异的光泽。
“这些畜生……”张三握紧拳头，指甲深深陷入掌心。
朱华音脸色苍白，但眼神冰冷如铁。她深吸一口气，强迫自己移开视线，望向蛛网镇方向。
镇子轮廓已在视野尽头浮现。
此刻，蛛网镇方向传来急促而沉重的钟声——
当！当！当！
警钟长鸣！
一声接一声，在黎明前的寂静中传得极远，带着显而易见的慌乱与绝望。

紧接着，镇西城墙角楼上，一点火光骤然亮起！
是烽火！
负责了望的卫兵点燃了第一座烽火台，橘红色的火焰冲天而起，浓烟笔直上升。
这是最高级别的警报，意味着灭顶之灾即将来临！
只要烽火传递下去，附近的军队也会跟随烽火行动。
然而，烽火仅仅燃烧了不到十息——
“嘶——！！！”
数十只脸盆大小的鬼面毒蛛不知何时已爬上角楼！它们从城墙阴影中窜出，八条长腿如镰刀般挥舞，瞬间将那名点烽火的卫兵撕成碎片！
紧接着，更多的蜘蛛涌上烽火台，用粘稠的蛛网和身躯扑向火焰！
嗤——！
火焰在蛛网与体液的覆盖下迅速熄灭，浓烟也随之消散。
仅仅片刻，这座刚刚点燃的烽火台，便彻底沉寂下去。
而镇中其他几处预备点燃的烽火点，显然也遭到了同样的命运，片刻后再无一点火光升起。
“这些蜘蛛真是古怪，它们为什么知道要先解决烽火台？总之，来不及了……”朱华音咬牙道，“兽潮前锋已抵近城墙！我们必须立刻行动！”
朱华音不再犹豫，手中魂印亮起，白银玄凤笛落在手中。
虽然魂力尚未恢复，魂力增幅效果也称不上多好，但吹奏那首刺激魂兽的曲目，本就不需要魂力加持。
笛身横在唇边，朱华音闭目凝神，随后——
“呜——咿——嘎——！！！”
那诡异、急促、仿佛能直刺灵魂深处的旋律，骤然响起！
在黎明空旷的原野上，笛声传得极远。

果然，兽潮边缘区域，一群正在朝蛛网镇侧翼移动的低级蜘蛛魂兽，动作猛然一滞！
它们八只复眼中的幽绿光芒骤然炽盛，齐刷刷转向笛声传来的方向！短暂的迟疑后，这群大约百余只十年、百年层次的蜘蛛，脱离了大部队，朝着坡地这边疯狂爬来！
“有效！”张三眼睛一亮。
content_en:
Before dawn, in the chaos between night and dawn, Zhang San and Zhu Huayin rushed along the muddy path in the forest.
The air was filled with an increasingly strong smell of blood and the unique fishy smell of soul beasts.
Messy spider footprints began to appear on the ground, some of which were several inches deep. They were obviously left by huge elite soul beasts.
The further you go, the denser the traces become, and the soil is turned into a mess.
"Almost..." Zhu Huayin lowered his voice and looked solemn. Although her soul power has not yet recovered, her Soul Saint-level perception is still sharp. "Three miles ahead, the soul power fluctuations are extremely dense...and there are a lot of them."
The two looked at each other and quickened their pace.
Passing through a sparse forest, the scene ahead suddenly came into view.
Beneath a slope, the originally peaceful fields and village roads were now completely covered by a creeping black torrent!
Thousands of spider soul beasts are rushing towards Spider Web Town like a tidal wave bursting from a dam! The small one is as big as a fist, the big one is like a millstone, the gray-black carapace reflects an icy luster in the dim light of dawn, the eight green compound eyes merge into a sea of ​​deathly light, and the rustling crawling sounds merge into a scalp-numbing low cry.
And on the road where the black torrent passed, there was no grass growing.
A few farmhouses scattered around the edges of the fields were in ruins. Thatched roofs were overturned, earth walls collapsed, and broken farm tools and mud-stained clothes were scattered in the yard.
A carcass that had been chewed down to only a skeleton was half-buried under a collapsed fence. The head rolled to the side, and its empty eye sockets looked at the gray sky.
A small village further away has turned into a hell on earth. Flames jumped on several houses, and black smoke billowed up, mixing with the morning fog. Broken carriages and scattered corpses can be seen everywhere on the village road. Some are stuck to the wall by spider webs, and some are torn into pieces. The dark red blood is soaked in the soil, glowing with a strange luster in the dim light.
"These beasts..." Zhang San clenched his fists and dug his nails into his palms.
Zhu Huayin's face was pale, but his eyes were as cold as iron. She took a deep breath, forced herself to look away, and looked in the direction of Spider Web Town.
The outline of the town has emerged at the end of the field of vision.
At this moment, a rapid and heavy bell sounded from the direction of Spider Web Town——
Dang! when! when!
Alarm bells are ringing!
One after another, they carried far away in the pre-dawn silence, carrying obvious panic and despair.
Immediately afterwards, a fire suddenly lit up on the corner tower of the west wall of the town!
It’s beacon fire!
The guard in charge of the lookout lit the first beacon tower, orange flames shot into the sky, and thick smoke rose straight up.
This is the highest level of alarm, which means disaster is coming!
As long as the beacon fire continues, nearby armies will follow the beacon fire.
However, the beacon only burned for less than ten breaths——
"Hiss-!!!"
Dozens of ghost-faced poisonous spiders the size of washbasins have climbed onto the turret at some point! They burst out from the shadow of the city wall, waving their eight long legs like scythes, and instantly tore the guard who lit the beacon into pieces!
Immediately afterwards, more spiders swarmed onto the beacon tower and threw themselves at the flames with their sticky webs and bodies!
laugh--!
The flames were quickly extinguished under the cover of cobwebs and body fluids, and the thick smoke also dissipated.
In just a moment, the newly lit beacon tower fell into complete silence.
Several other beacon points in the town that were about to be lit apparently suffered the same fate. After a while, no more flames rose.
"These spiders are really weird. Why do they know to deal with the Beacon Tower first? In short, it's too late..." Zhu Huayin gritted his teeth and said, "The frontline of the beast tide has reached the city wall! We must act immediately!"
Zhu Huayin no longer hesitated, the soul mark in his hand lit up, and the silver black phoenix flute fell into his hand.
Although the soul power has not yet been restored, and the soul power amplification effect is not very good, playing the song that stimulates the soul beast does not require the blessing of soul power.
flute bodyCrossing his lips, Zhu Huayin closed his eyes and concentrated, and then——
"Woo-ee-ga-!!!"
That strange, urgent melody that seemed to pierce the depths of the soul suddenly sounded!
In the open fields at dawn, the sound of the flute spreads very far.
Sure enough, at the edge of the beast tide, a group of low-level spider soul beasts that were moving towards the flanks of Spider Web Town suddenly stopped moving!
The green light in their eight compound eyes suddenly blazed, and they all turned towards the direction where the flute sound came from! After a brief hesitation, this group of about a hundred ten-year and century-level spiders broke away from the large army and crawled crazily towards the slope!
"It works!" Zhang San's eyes lit up.
